raw_comment: In this graph, we see the droughts taking place throughout the country and the droughts’ extremities. I noticed how many states within the country's interior are experiencing exceptional or severe droughts while some states on the outskirts and exterior of the country face abnormally dry droughts, but nothing as serious. I also saw how most of the states are facing some degree of drought with many different severity levels. I wonder why there are so many droughts taking place during this time and if they are causing wildfires and affecting the air quality. I also wonder if these droughts will soon be replaced by a rainy season that will cause flooding around the country or if it will stay dry for the upcoming months. This relates to my community and me because, in New Jersey, there was an extreme drought that caused many wildfires and affected the air quality. On many occasions, we could smell the smoke throughout each day from wildfires that were caused by this dryness and lack of rain. A headline could be: “Droughts drying the country.”
